messages:
Harper: Planning a short "latch" blue->green tonight 23:30 UTC for a router affinity tweak and tiny hotspot mitigation. Want ephemeral pin so split key isn't mutated later. Deploy bot scheduled. Need rollback rules & who runs post-smoke.
Eli: Proposal: 4 steps: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 4m cadence. Start with 10% warm for 12m. Add a quiet window from 23:30-00:30 to avoid noisy downstream jobs.
Sofia: I'm oncall. Abort conditions: p95 increase > 220ms sustained 4m OR error rate delta > 1% over 3m OR router misroute > 0.4% over 10k sessions. Also abort if LB queue depth > 45s average.
Mika: Add infra signal: if node CPU > 92% for 5m, abort. Ephemeral pin: we pin at start then auto-unpin 1h after full completion.
Harper: Release note short: "router: affinity latch + hotspot smoothing (no downtime)". I'll draft full notes post-success.
Deploy Bot: Shift requested by @Harper for 2024-07-10T23:30:00Z. ID: shift-20240710-042. Plan: [10(warm 12m),20,30,40] cadence=4m watchers=[Sofia,Mika]. Ephemeral pin behavior set.
Deploy Bot: Preflight checks: routing diff OK, canary health PASS, split-key pinned? PENDING.
Eli: Pinning now: `/router pin ephemeral-latch-20240710` -> OK.
Deploy Bot: split-key pin: OK. Preflight FINAL: PASS.
Sofia: I'll watch dashboards. If abort, I'll post "abort shift-20240710-042" and tag @oncall-sre.
Mika: I'll run post-step infra checks and smoke for auth.
Eli: ops-config snippet: 
```
latch_shift:
  steps: [10,20,30,40]
  cadence_mins: 4
  warmup_min: 12
  abort:
    p95_delta_ms: 220
    err_delta_pct: 1.0
    misroute_pct: 0.4
    lb_queue_s_avg: 45
    node_cpu_pct: 92
  ephemeral_pin_ttl_minutes: 60
```
Harper: 30m reminder set.
Deploy Bot: Reminder: shift-20240710-042 starts in 30m.
Deploy Bot: Shift started. step=1 -> 10% warm. metrics: p95=115ms base=100ms delta=15ms err=0.1% misroute=0%
Mika: auth smoke pass. infra checks nominal.
Deploy Bot: step=2 -> 30%. metrics: p95=125ms delta=25ms err=0.12% misroute=0.02% node_cpu=68%
Sofia: all quiet so far.
Deploy Bot: step=3 -> 60%. metrics: p95=150ms delta=50ms err=0.2% misroute=0.1% node_cpu=70%
Eli: seeing a small backend queue bump in eu-central but under threshold.
Deploy Bot: step=4 -> 100% complete. shift-20240710-042 status: SUCCESS. Ephemeral pin set to auto-unpin after 60m.
Harper: Great. Mika run final smoke and then I'll post release note in #releases after 1h quiet window.
Mika: final smoke: pass for auth + session-affinity. No misroutes detected.
Sofia: Standing down watch. If anything appears in the next hour, we'll revert using `abort shift-20240710-042` and `/router rollback ephemeral-latch-20240710`.
Harper: Posting release note: "router: affinity latch + hotspot smoothing deployed; no user-facing downtime."
Eli: Unpin will auto-run at 2024-07-11T01:10:00Z per ephemeral_pin_ttl.
Deploy Bot: shift-20240710-042 closed: SUCCESS. Canary seed remains 0.5% for 1h post-shift for monitoring.
Harper: Adding a brief runbook note about ephemeral pins and the latch pattern. Thanks all. :rocket:
